youNeed: A live homepage, which their own field note asks you to confirm A category from their fixed list of thirty A pricing model that is one of free, paid or freemium
submit_steps: 1 Open the add form /ai/add-new. No account, no captcha and nothing gated: the form is public and complete on one screen.
2 Fill nine fields Full name, email, tool name, tool URL, a short description, a full description, a category, a price model and a lifetime-deal checkbox.
3 Press Submit Tool Two calls fire, one storing the record and one sending the owner a notification, and the form clears itself.

submit_requirements: Category one of their thirty, such as SEO, Marketing or Productivity
Lifetime deal optional checkbox, off by default
rejection_reasons: A tool already listed in the directory: the form tells you to check first Anything with no AI angle at all

The form asks you to check the tool is not already listed, and there is no search on the form itself to do it with: you have to go through the directory first.
Price is a closed choice of Free, Paid or Freemium, so anything with an unusual model has to be squeezed into one of the three.
